text.formatted: The tyrannosaurus makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail. It can't make both attacks against the same target.
text.plain: The tyrannosaurus makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail. It can't make both attacks against the same target.

text.formatted: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 33 (4d12 + 7) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is Grappled (escape DC 17). Until this grapple ends, the target is Restrained, and the tyrannosaurus can't bite another target.
